summary.text: Michael Riker is the Republican nominee for the Maryland House of Delegates, District 23 (3 seats), in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a retired Prince George's County police detective.

paragraphs.text: Michael Riker graduated from Crossland High School and has a career in law enforcement.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he has lived in the county and in Maryland since 1968.
He led the June 23, 2026 Republican primary with 50.7% of the vote.
His stated campaign messages are no new taxes and fees, strong support for public safety, and repeal of vehicle registration fees.
